_comment: The one place the app's deployment settings live. build.py reads this and
emits it into shell.js, so nothing has to be edited in two places.
licenceEndpoint MUST be changed before a store build. The placeholder host
below does not resolve, which makes an unconfigured build fail loudly at
sign-in instead of quietly letting everyone in.
Whatever host you use also has to be listed in WKAppBoundDomains in
ios/App/App/Info.plist, or iOS will refuse the request.
